rationale: With AIR 1's scan complete and this being the final wave, we are deploying all three drones (leaving none in reserve) to maximize life-saving intel. D1 will verify trapped signs and resolve major damage disagreements on heavily occupied towers along the Pine and Battery corridor, while D2 surveys unscanned high-occupancy blocks at Rincon Annex and the Pacific Gas & Electric Building. D3 will sweep the unscanned, densely populated 50 Fremont Center block where up to 21% collapse probability is predicted.

missions.purpose: Confirm trapped signs at 100 Battery St and resolve damage calls at Hyatt Regency, 100 Pine, and 235 Pine.
Survey unscanned high-occupancy buildings at Rincon Annex and the Pacific Gas & Electric Building block for extensive damage.
Sweep the unscanned SoMa steel block at 50 Fremont Center to check over 3,100 occupants for predicted collapses.
